blocks.orig: A walk from Materuni to the Kuringe waterfalls is perfect for those who want to experience Mount Kilimanjaro without actually climbing it! From Materuni a local guide takes you on a beautiful walk to the amazing 70-meter-high waterfall in a 40-minute walk. At 2,500 meters above sea level, the path leads through valleys and tropical rain forests, alternating between splendid wide views and plantations full of coffee, bananas, and avocados.
blocks.html: Would you like to experience Mount Kilimanjaro without the climb? Then the walk from Materuni to the Kuringe waterfalls suits you perfectly! A local guide sets off with you from Materuni, and after 40 minutes of lovely walking you reach the impressive waterfall, 70 meters high. The path runs at 2,500 meters above sea level through tropical rain forests and valleys, with splendid views opening up between plantations of coffee, bananas and avocados.

blocks.orig: Duration: Full day (starts early in the morning)
blocks.html: Duration: a full day (with an early morning start)
